newsitem.title: USA: Barbers acquires We Care Hair Salon chain.
newsitem.headline: Barbers acquires We Care Hair Salon chain.

text.p: The Barbers Hairstyling for Men and Women Inc said Monday it completed the acquisition of the trademark asnd franchise agreements of We Care Hair Development Inc, a Chicago-based chain.
The purchase price was $2 million, plus a percentage of future royalties.
We Care Hair has about 140 salons throughout the United States and Mexico, with a concentration in Illinois, Indiana and Ohio.
The Barbers Hairstyling provides hairstyling and hair care products through 940 franchised and company-owned salons.
